heading.html: King Spa’s Curated Spa Treatment Menu

children.text: At King Spa Virginia, we blend ancient healing traditions with modern wellness to offer a truly rejuvenating experience. Our expert therapists provide customized spa treatments, including massages, facials, V-steam therapy, and Korean body scrubs, designed for relaxation, skin rejuvenation, and holistic healing. As a leading wellness center in Virginia, we focus on natural techniques that restore balance and enhance well-being. Indulge in the ultimate self-care experience and discover deep relaxation at King Spa Virginia.

*All treatments must be booked on-site and are first-come, first-served.
*An 18% gratuity will be added on service and can be adjusted at checkout.

children.html:
Joanna Pascua-Colasito

One of the best spas in Virginia! I truly enjoyed myself. Definitely will return when I am in that area. Customer service was excellent. Facility is very clean. Food was also great. Massages are bit pricey but they do a great job. I was disappointed that the towels were hand towels instead of bath towels for the pool side. We ended up taking more hand towels to dry off.
Florentino Morales-Lechuga

What an amazing place, they have lots to do and as long as you want. Food is good and staff won’t bother you. Follow all the rules, no shoes, no flip flops. Very clean and relaxing. 80 bucks per person to get it but you can stay until they close. I personally would go by myself, so you don’t have to worry about time limit. The they have a restaurant and is also pretty good Came on a Wednesday around 12pm and it wasn’t crowded, just enough to people. In the locker room they have their own all nude jacuzzi and spa room. I’m pretty sure they have one for women.
Andrea Whitely

Visited Kings Spa for my birthday and it was amazing! Great weekday pricing and clean, sanitized, and beautiful establishment. The massage services were relaxing with the right amount of pressure. Food was a bit pricey but satisfying and delicious. It would be helpful if there was a guided welcome tour but otherwise I’m excited to go again!
Tashana Fustino

Very professional and quick service everywhere in this place! Even my husband enjoyed his time here, and he is usually really picky. They have the option to skip the naked spa area if you're uncomfortable, but it's very relaxing in there, and no one is judging, so just do it! The outdoor pool is heated, but I'll probably still enjoy it more in the summertime. The food here was great as well. Like everything.
Annie O'Shea-Weed

Amazing experience. The entire facility was extremely clean and didn't make walking around barefoot feel weird. You can wear socks or buy grippy socks once you arrive. We went on a Sunday around noon it started to get busy around 3, but since the facility is so large there was always a sauna to go into that wasn't overly crowded. The outdoor bade area had the best overhead water massages!
Heidi Gaston

I love this place! Even when crowded it’s so spacious you still do everything you want to do. If you do any service they give you a free pass to come back so it makes it a deal. I always sleep so well the night after. I spend most the day just relaxing and sweating! Lava rock putting out natural infrared rays is my favorite. Cold plunge in the locker room is awesome. I get the scrub! It’s so great! Love

heading.html: How to Book Your Spa Treatment

children.cls: elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-2024924 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default

children.text: All treatment appointments are made on-site at King Spa. We do not take online reservations for treatments, so we recommend arriving early to book your preferred time.

Choose from our extensive menu of luxurious spa treatments for men, women, and couples and choose the best time for you. Our staff will explain our different treatments and help you choose the best one.
Meet at your treatment area at the time of your appointment. For body scrubs, be sure to soak in the hot tubs for at least 15 min prior to treatment. And finally, enjoy your spa treatment!

children.html:
How do I book a spa treatment?

Most treatments can be booked at our reservation kiosk on the second floor, including all men’s spa treatments, massages, facials, and couple’s treatments. To book a women’s body scrub or V-steam, please visit the reservation kiosk in the women’s locker room.

﻿﻿Do you offer couple's massages?

Yes, any massage can be given as a couple’s massage. The price is double.

Is gratuity included in the price?

No, gratuity is not included in the price listed. An 18% gratuity will be added to the final bill upon checkout, which can be adjusted.

What types of spa treatments are available at King Spa Virginia?

We offer a variety of treatments, including massages, facials, Korean body scrubs, couple’s treatments, hydrotherapy, and V-steam therapy. Whether you’re looking for stress relief, skin renewal, or full-body relaxation, our services cater to a range of wellness needs.

How do I prepare for my spa treatment?

For the best experience, arrive early to book your treatment and relax before your session. Drink plenty of water and avoid heavy meals beforehand. If you’re getting a body scrub, we recommend avoiding shaving or too much sun exposure right before and after the treatment.

Do I need to book an appointment in advance?

Treatments are booked in person on a first-come, first-served basis. Popular services tend to fill up quickly, especially on weekends, so we recommend arriving early to secure a booking.

What are the benefits of body scrubs and hydrotherapy?

Body scrubs remove dead skin cells, improve circulation, and leave your skin feeling smooth and refreshed. Hydrotherapy helps relieve muscle tension, boost circulation, and promote overall relaxation by using water’s natural healing properties.

Are there any spa treatments suitable for first-time visitors?

While all our spa treatments are suitable for everyone, first-time visitors often enjoy a Swedish massage for relaxation, a hydrating facial for a glowing complexion, or a Korean body scrub for deep exfoliation. Our staff can also recommend treatments based on your needs.

What does my King Spa day pass include?

Your day pass grants access to locker rooms, steam rooms, saunas, indoor and outdoor pools, jacuzzis, and lounge areas. It also includes spa uniforms, towels, and toiletries. Spa treatments, food, and beverages are available at an additional cost.

children.text: *For more details, visit our official FAQ page on the website.
